user.description:
A heat pump can be set up in Home Assistant in two different ways.

You can reach it over the network, which covers a Modbus TCP bridge or an RS485-to-network adapter that speaks Modbus TCP, or over a serial port its RS485 terminals are wired to, which covers ports shared over the network by a serial proxy.

The heat pump faults with the error CH 03 when nothing asks it for data for five minutes, so keep Home Assistant polling it.

tcp.description: Set up a heat pump reached over the network, either directly or through a Modbus TCP bridge.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the device or its Modbus TCP gateway.
data_description.port: The Modbus TCP port to connect to.
data_description.unit_id: The heat pump's Modbus unit ID, as set on its control panel under Connectivity > Modbus address.
data_description.meter_unit_id: The Modbus unit ID of an Eastron SDM120 energy meter on the same line, if the heat pump's electricity use is measured by one. Leave empty if there is none.
data_description.from_december_2023: Turn this on if the heat pump was made in December 2023 or later. It adds the heat pump's own energy measurement and the compressor modulation, which older products do not have and refuse to answer.

serial.description: Set up a heat pump wired to a serial port over RS485.

data_description.device: Select a local serial port or a port shared over the network by a serial proxy.
data_description.baudrate: The speed of the RS485 bus. The Therma V uses 9600.
data_description.unit_id: The heat pump's Modbus unit ID, as set on its control panel under Connectivity > Modbus address.
data_description.meter_unit_id: The Modbus unit ID of an Eastron SDM120 energy meter on the same line, if the heat pump's electricity use is measured by one. Leave empty if there is none.
data_description.from_december_2023: Turn this on if the heat pump was made in December 2023 or later. It adds the heat pump's own energy measurement and the compressor modulation, which older products do not have and refuse to answer.

reconfigure.description: Update where this heat pump is reached, for example after it moved to another address or its RS485 bus was rewired. Moving it between a network and a serial connection keeps this entry and its history.

reconfigure_tcp.description: Reach this heat pump over the network, either directly or through a Modbus TCP bridge.

error.heat_pump_silent: The adapter is reachable, but the heat pump behind it did not answer. Check the unit ID, the adapter's serial settings and that Modbus is enabled on the heat pump.
error.meter_silent: The adapter is reachable, but the energy meter behind it did not answer. Check the meter's unit ID and baud rate, or leave the meter empty.
error.december_2023_not_supported: The heat pump refused the registers of products from December 2023 or later. Turn that option off if it is an older product.

modbus_error.message: Error communicating with the heat pump.

write_failed.message: Failed to write to the heat pump.

invalid_compressor_modulation.message: The compressor modulation is 0 (not used) or {minimum} to {maximum}.
